chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from ʿAlī ibn Riʾāb, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: concerning
A man who carried his slave upon his riding animal, and it trampled a man; so he said: “The liability is upon his master.”

key_terms.اَلْغُرْمُ: financial liability or compensation due for damage
key_terms.دَابَّتِهِ: his riding animal or beast used for transport
key_terms.عَبْدَهُ: his slave; the owned servant whose act is under discussion
key_terms.فَوَطِئَتْ: then it trampled; indicating the injurious act
key_terms.مَوْلَاهُ: his master; the one held responsible for the compensation

ai.seo_question: Who bears liability if a slave on his master’s riding animal injures someone?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning liability for harm caused by a slave while on an animal. The Imam عليه السلام states that financial responsibility falls upon the slave’s master, indicating the master's legal accountability in this case.
